newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia rupiah weakens on ample supply.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia rupiah weakens on ample supply.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah weakened against the dollar in early trading on Friday amid sustained ample liquidity, dealers said.
Spot rupiah was quoted at 2,402.00/02.50 at 0335 GMT against an opening of 2,399.50/400.50.
"Rupiah liquidity remains ample, with overnight call money hovering at between five to six percent," one foreign bank dealer said.
Rupiah selling by some London-based operators further dampened sentiment on the currency, he said.
